notes: Single-stage: combine four scattered artifacts (KEY=VALUE env with comment/last-wins rules, a slot table with exact-name matching, a markdown note hiding the prime, a roster whose active lines are counted) into one integer payload via exact modular arithmetic. Nonzero rubric for reasoning_depth (four interacting rules), adversarial_inputs (comment decoys, near-miss names, duplicated keys/slots), hidden_case_generalization (verifier runs the program on hidden state dirs), and quantitative_correctness (exact payload). No tool breadth, dependency chain, or pressure; buckets to easy.
